about_short_description.short_description: Venta is an AI sales agent that automates B2B lead generation, contact research, and compliant sales outreach.

product.name: Venta AI
product.description: An AI-driven sales assistant that automates lead research, contact identification, and personalized outreach while ensuring GDPR compliance in Europe.

product.name: Optimized E-Mail Infrastructure
product.description: A managed email sending system that ensures high deliverability of outreach emails through domain rotation, AI-generated unique messages, and optimized sending schedules.

product.name: LinkedIn Automation
product.description: An AI-powered tool to automate LinkedIn outreach by managing multiple accounts, sending contact requests, messages, and profile visits while avoiding duplicate contacts.

product.name: Find Relevant Contacts
product.description: An AI-based contact discovery service that identifies and provides accurate, up-to-date contact details from multiple GDPR-compliant sources and real-time web scraping.

product.name: Buying Signals
product.description: A feature that identifies companies showing interest through website visits, job postings, or trade fair participation to prioritize outreach efforts.
